entry.title: Let familiar faces meet their gaze
entry.summary: A family photograph or picture of something familiar can give your baby something to notice at their own height.
entry.cue: You are looking at what your baby can see from where they spend time.
detail: The authors suggest a couple of pictures of familiar people, animals or nature. Personal, handmade touches can belong beside them; the room need not follow one neutral style.
This is about a picture being visible from the baby’s position. The book does not make an elaborate display a requirement.
